_readme: Pre-registration for the CPR reversal/breakout candidate study. Parameters and the full variant list are declared HERE before any result was produced. No threshold may be changed after results are seen; any additional run must be appended to 'unplanned_runs' with a reason.
research_scope: Underlying (spot) signal study. Historical option premiums are absent from this deployment, so credit-spread premium P&L is NOT claimed anywhere in this research (see data_quality_report.md).

production_baseline.execution: entry = next candle open in [09:20,15:20); exits at subsequent opens; stop 0.5% checked before target 2%; flat at the 15:20 open; first trigger per session; sessions with fewer than 10 scan candles or without a 15:20 candle are skipped
production_baseline.labelling: win/loss via production decay_win (short-premium tolerance: NIFTY 30 pts, BANKNIFTY 60 pts)
production_baseline.reported_cost: COST_R_PER_TRADE = 0.10R per round trip (production display placeholder)

periods._note: Chronological, no shuffling. Rule development only in in_sample; variant selection only in validation; out_of_sample is untouched until the final comparison.

walkforward.block_split: contiguous equal-count blocks of session dates over the full range
walkforward._note: Rules are fixed, not fitted; blocks measure stability, and the selection track measures whether validation-style choice generalises forward.

levels.cpr: pp=(H+L+C)/3, bc=(H+L)/2, tc=2*pp-bc (swapped if inverted) - production calculate_cpr
levels.pivots: r1=2*pp-L, s1=2*pp-H, r2=pp+(H-L), s2=pp-(H-L) - production pivot_levels
levels.point_in_time: strictly prior session only (SQL: substr(timestamp,1,10) < day)

execution_model.entry: open of the candle AFTER the trigger candle, must satisfy 09:20 <= time < 15:20
execution_model.exits: subsequent candle OPENS only; stop checked before target; flat at the 15:20 open; session without a 15:20 candle is dropped
execution_model.parity: identical to the baseline so that the comparison isolates signal selection

exit_model_structure.stop: reversal: rejection candle extreme; breakout: the broken level
exit_model_structure.target: next relevant level beyond entry (PP/BC/TC/S1/S2/PDL downward, PP/TC/BC/R1/R2/PDH upward); none -> run to stop or 15:20

bearish_rejection_requires: close < level (closes back below: a close beyond the level is a break, not a rejection)
bullish_hold_requires: close > level (holds or reclaims; a close through the level is a breakdown)
reversal_rules.entry_trigger_bear: first later candle whose LOW breaks the confirmation candle's low; entry at the next open
reversal_rules.entry_trigger_bull: first later candle whose HIGH breaks the confirmation candle's high; entry at the next open
reversal_rules.wick_only: a wick through a level that closes beyond it never confirms a reversal
reversal_rules.family_scan_order: candle-major, then level order A2,A1,A4,A3 / B2,B1,B4,B3 (production tie order)

breakout_rules.confirmation: completed candle CLOSE beyond the level with the previous close on the other side (fresh cross; wick-only breaks never confirm)

follow_through.meaning: the next `follow_through` candles must all CLOSE beyond the level; entry at the open of the candle after them. A close back through the level is observed BEFORE entry, so a failed break is a legal pre-entry filter.

breakout_rules.retest_variant: wait for a pullback to within retest_band of the level that then CLOSES back beyond it; entry at the next open. Failures are detected in the same forward walk, always before entry.
breakout_rules.failed_break_rule: first cross of a level that fails (close back through within the check window, or before the holding retest) disqualifies that level for the session
breakout_rules.reward_filter: distance from entry to the next relevant level must be >= min_level_rr x (exit stop risk); unmeasurable (no next level) -> not filtered, flagged in evidence
breakout_rules.friday: candidate applies NO Friday skip (tested under the same criteria as other sessions); the baseline's Friday gate is preserved unchanged

hierarchy: 3. conflicting bull+bear reversals in one session -> earliest confirmation wins (tie -> BEAR, production priority); conflict_rule='reject' tested as an ablation
4. one trade per session per instrument; extra candidates counted as duplicates
6. nothing met the conditions -> NO TRADE

costs.sensitivity: net expectancy is reported at every grid point for both sides
costs.charges_note: exchange charges/STT/GST/stamp duty are not separately modelled because no real order is executed in this system (paper only); the brokerage+slippage model is applied IDENTICALLY to baseline and candidate.

capital.formula: capital_base = risk_rs / 0.01 where risk_rs = entry x stop_pct x lot
capital.note: Same denominator for baseline and candidate: one position open at a time, flat overnight, so peak capital = capital_base. Also reported as return on a flat 100000 Rs/instrument production-research reference.

risk_limits._small_sample_warning: out-of-sample holds 12 sessions x 2 instruments; every OOS win rate must be reported with its sample size and interval.

promotion_gates.G1_oos_expectancy: candidate OOS net expectancy per trade > baseline OOS net expectancy per trade
promotion_gates.G2_survives_costs: candidate advantage still > 0 on the reported cost grid (at least at the production 0.10R cost)
promotion_gates.G3_drawdown_within_limits: G3a max drawdown <= max_drawdown_pct_of_capital; G3b <= 1.5x baseline; G3c largest single loss <= max_single_loss_pct_of_capital
promotion_gates.G5_no_bias: unit tests + data-quality + PIT/look-ahead tests all PASS and the cost/execution model is identical
promotion_gates.G6_robustness: net expectancy positive in >= 2 of 3 periods and >= 2 of 3 walk-forward blocks per instrument; both instruments not materially negative
promotion_gates.G7_credit_spread_economics: requires real historical option premiums; BLOCKED if option history is absent
promotion_gates._rule: Any gate that cannot be executed -> INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS. Even a full pass stops at human review.
